from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A financial liability record extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as identified in the document")
    total_liabilities_amount: float | None = Field(description="The value of total liabilities as reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the liability figure (e.g. USD)")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which the liabilities are reported")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="The section of the report where this data was found")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
